name: hcp
description: Human Context Protocol: clickable cards, handoffs, no-reply notes, and a reach contract that holds calls contacting people for your OK

typesafe_api_key.title: Jev API key
typesafe_api_key.description: Judges calls the reach rules can't place. Optional: without it the session's haiku judges instead.

langfuse_public_key.title: Langfuse public key
langfuse_public_key.description: Optional. With all three Langfuse fields set, every run is a trace and every card answer a score.

langfuse_secret_key.title: Langfuse secret key
langfuse_secret_key.description: Optional. Pairs with the public key.

langfuse_base_url.title: Langfuse URL
langfuse_base_url.description: Optional. Your Langfuse region, e.g. https://us.cloud.langfuse.com.
